visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Panel never opens
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The menu should open when the checkbox is ticked, but it stays hidden. The panel is not the next element after the checkbox, so the selector cannot reach it.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: Home | About

solution.code: Home | About
solution.explanation: The + selector matches only the element that comes straight after. With a label between the checkbox and the menu, #open:checked + .menu matches nothing. Move the menu right after the checkbox, or use the ~ selector for any later sibling.

checks.label: Ticking the box shows the menu
